skills.name: PostKing
skills.description: Entry point for day-to-day PostKing content work — pick or confirm the active brand, then route to the right specialist skill for social posts, blogs, landing pages, SEO/GEO, campaigns, competitors, Reddit, brand voice, or first-time setup.

skills.name: PostKing · Social
skills.description: Generate, approve, and schedule social posts on PostKing across LinkedIn, X/Twitter, Instagram, Threads, and Facebook — plan a recurring weekly content cadence (Smart Week), repurpose a URL/blog/text/existing post into platform-tailored posts, pick or regenerate a post visual, and pull trending hooks for inspiration.

skills.name: PostKing · Blog
skills.description: Create blog publications and generate, iterate on, and publish blog articles on PostKing — PostKing-hosted or pushed to connected external platforms like WordPress, Medium, or Substack — and check generation/publish status.

skills.name: PostKing · Landing Pages
skills.description: Generate, edit, vibe-edit, and publish landing pages on PostKing, including side pages (comparison/text/landing sub-pages) and custom domains — for product launches, campaigns, and standalone marketing pages.

skills.name: PostKing · SEO
skills.description: Run SEO / GEO from seed keywords to published, AI-citation-friendly articles using PostKing — seed, expand, cluster, roadmap, brief, write, and publish.

skills.name: PostKing · Getting Started
skills.description: First-run flow for PostKing — connect and authenticate, check/top-up credits or subscribe, then onboard a first brand from a URL, connect socials, and ship a first post.

skills.name: PostKing · Storylines
skills.description: Launch a full marketing campaign end-to-end with PostKing — brief, strategy, and multi-channel content generation — using the Storylines tools.

skills.name: PostKing · Competitor Intel
skills.description: Discover, register, and analyze a brand's competitors in PostKing — probe for rival domains, classify candidates, add them as tracked competitors, and pull comparison/overview intelligence.

skills.name: PostKing · Reddit
skills.description: Build a fit-scored subreddit pool for a brand, match content to the best communities with posting angles, and natively rewrite a post for a specific subreddit before a human posts it.

skills.name: PostKing · Brand Voice
skills.description: List and apply saved PostKing voice profiles when generating or rewriting content, and run the de-slop / humanize / AI-detection pass on any text.
